access_level.desc: For `canvas` views: access level granted to the channel for the canvas tab. Defaults to `write`. Use `comment` to grant channel members comment access (read and comment, no editing) so the agent remains the sole author of the canvas text. _Acceptable values:_ `read` `write` `comment`

agent_content_hash.desc: For `canvas` views: hash of the canvas-derived markdown the agent last wrote, recorded so the agent can later detect human edits to the canvas. Opaque to the server.

base_branch.desc: For `diff` views: base branch name for display purposes. The optional `base_branch` and `head_branch` arguments are display-only labels shown in the diff header.

blocks.desc: Block Kit blocks to render in the view tab. Required when `type` is `block_kit`; ignored otherwise.

canvas_id.desc: Encoded ID of the canvas to attach as the view. Required when `type` is `canvas`; ignored otherwise.

channel_id.desc: ID of the code channel to render the view in.

content.desc: View content. For `html`, a full self-contained HTML document; for `diff`, raw unified diff text. Capped at 1,000,000 bytes; larger content returns `content_too_large`. The cap is enforced by the handler (not schema `maxLength`) so the documented error code actually surfaces instead of a generic argument-validation failure. Required when `type` is `html` or `diff`.

csp.desc: Content-Security-Policy domain declarations for the view. Domains are validated server-side (`https://` only, no private or internal hosts) and persisted.

head_branch.desc: For `diff` views: head branch name for display purposes. The optional `base_branch` and `head_branch` arguments are display-only labels shown in the diff header.

label.desc: Deprecated alias for `name`. Display label for the view tab. Defaults to the last path segment of `view_key`, stripped of any `.html` or `.htm` extension.

name.desc: Display label for the view tab. Preferred over the legacy `label` argument (`name` wins if both are supplied). Defaults to the last path segment of `view_key`, stripped of any `.html` or `.htm` extension.

type.desc: The kind of view to create or update. Defaults to `html`. Determines which other arguments are required: `html` and `diff` require `content`, `block_kit` requires `blocks`, and `canvas` requires `canvas_id`.

view_key.desc: Agent-assigned stable identity for the view (e.g. the source file path on the agent's machine). Used as the upsert key: calls with the same `view_key` update the same view. Required for `html`, `block_kit`, and `canvas` views; ignored for `diff` (a `diff` view is a per-channel singleton).

desc: Create or update a view in a code channel.

errors.canvas_not_found: The specified `canvas_id` does not correspond to a canvas you can access.
errors.channel_not_found: The specified channel does not correspond to a valid channel.
errors.content_too_large: The view content exceeds the maximum allowed size (1 MB).
errors.invalid_blocks: The supplied `blocks` failed Block Kit validation.
errors.invalid_csp_domain: One or more declared CSP domains failed validation (must be `https://` origins, no private, reserved, or internal hosts).
errors.invalid_view_type: The supplied `type` is not a recognized view type.
errors.missing_required_arg: A required argument for the supplied view type is missing (`content` for `html` or `diff`, `blocks` for `block_kit`, `canvas_id` for `canvas`).
errors.not_agent_channel: The specified channel is not a code channel.
errors.not_authorized: The caller is not an authorized agent bot or member for this channel.
errors.not_view_owner: The view already exists and was created by a different agent bot; only its owner may update it.
errors.too_many_views: The channel already has the maximum number of views (5), or already has a `diff` view (at most 1 is allowed).
errors.view_creation_failed: The view could not be created as a channel tab.
